          "description": "Open a Citibank account online and enjoy online banking benefits. Experience seamless online banking with checking, savings and CD accounts today."

          "itemListElement": [

        {
          "@type": "ItemList",
          "name": "Open A Bank Account Online | Citi.com",
          "description": "Open a Citibank account online and enjoy online banking benefits. Experience seamless online banking with checking, savings and CD accounts today.",
          "url": "https://www.citi.com/banking/bank-accounts",
          "numberOfItems": 3,
          "itemListElement": [
            {
              "@type": "ListItem",
              "position": 1,
              "name": "Checking Accounts",
              "description": "Open a checking account with Citi to use mobile check deposit, online bill pay and more. Benefit from convenient banking when you open a checking account online.",
              "url": "https://www.citi.com/banking/checking-account"
            },
            {
              "@type": "ListItem",
              "position": 2,
              "name": "Savings Accounts",
              "description": "Open a Citi savings account online today and let your money grow with interest. Discover the benefits of opening a new savings account.",
              "url": "https://www.citi.com/banking/savings-account"
            },
            {
              "@type": "ListItem",
              "position": 3,
              "name": "Certificates of Deposit",
              "description": "A Citi Certificate of Deposit, or CD account, lets you earn interest on your savings. Learn more about CD accounts and open a CD account online today.",
              "url": "https://www.citi.com/banking/cd-account"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "@type": "FAQPage",
          "mainEntity": [
            {
              "@type": "Question",
              "name": "What types of bank accounts does Citi offer?",
              "acceptedAnswer": {
                "@type": "Answer",
                "text": "Citi offers Checking, Savings and Certificate of Deposit (CD) accounts to help you with your finances. You can choose between an Access Checking or Regular Checking account depending on your banking needs. With a Citi savings account, you can earn interest, get access to cash and save seamlessly with automatic transfers. In addition, Citi offers multiple CD term options ranging from three (3) months to five (5) years. You can enjoy Relationship Tier benefits and features when you open and maintain an eligible deposit account in addition to meeting a Balance Range of at least $30,000 within three (3) calendar months. Note: some benefits will vary, depending on which types of accounts you have.1"
              }
            },
            {
              "@type": "Question",
              "name": "What is simplified banking?",
              "acceptedAnswer": {
                "@type": "Answer",
                "text": "Through simplified banking, Citi is transforming the customer experience – whether you’re managing your everyday finances or growing your wealth. This includes streamlining our checking and savings products, providing new ways to waive Monthly Service Fees, introducing Relationship Tiers for increased benefits and features, and automatically linking Eligible Deposit and Investment accounts you own to help you meet balance requirements. Learn more about simplified banking."
              }
            },
            {
              "@type": "Question",
              "name": "What is required to open a bank account online with Citi?",
              "acceptedAnswer": {
                "@type": "Answer",
                "text": "To apply online, you must be a U.S. citizen or a U.S. resident alien and at least 18 years old. You'll need to provide a physical address in the U.S., date of birth and applicable identification documentation which may include a Social Security Number or Individual Taxpayer Identification number."
              }
            },
            {
              "@type": "Question",
              "name": "How do I open a Citibank Online account?",
              "acceptedAnswer": {
                "@type": "Answer",
                "text": "To get started with Citibank Online, you'll first need to open an account with Citi. Then, you'll need your Citi Credit/Debit Card or Bank Account number to set up online access. Once you’ve gathered all the necessary information, go to citi.com/register and follow the steps. You’ll need to enter the last four digits of your Social Security number or Individual Taxpayer Identification number and create a username and password."
              }
            },
            {
              "@type": "Question",
              "name": "How do I get started with mobile banking?",
              "acceptedAnswer": {
                "@type": "Answer",
                "text": "Getting started with Citi's mobile banking requires a few simple steps: Open an account with Citi. Visit citi.com/register to set up your login information and security authentication. This will require you to enter the last four digits of your Social Security number or Individual Taxpayer Identification number and set up a username and password. Download and open the free Citi Mobile banking app2 using the same login information you set up on Citi.com. Alternatively, you can set up your login information and security authentication directly in the Citi Mobile app. Once you've followed these steps, you'll be able to access mobile banking with ease."
              }
            },
            {
              "@type": "Question",
              "name": "How does Mobile Check Deposit work?",
              "acceptedAnswer": {
                "@type": "Answer",
                "text": "To make a Mobile Check Deposit2 with your Citi account, you'll first need to log in to your Citi Mobile app,2 then select “Payments” from the menu. Once there, select “Deposit Checks.” To complete a one-time enrollment before using the service, review and accept the terms & conditions. Select the account you're depositing the check into and enter the amount of the check (limits may apply). Once you've filled in those details, endorse your check and take a picture of the front and back through the mobile app. Tap “Submit” to upload the photos, and you will receive a confirmation email from Citi to let you know your check has been deposited."
              }
            },
            {
              "@type": "Question",
              "name": "How do online wire transfers work with Citi?",
              "acceptedAnswer": {
                "@type": "Answer",
                "text": "An online wire transfer allows you to send money from your Citibank account to accounts at other financial institutions in the US and internationally. Depending on the international destination, a wire may be sent in USD or in the local foreign currency. To initiate a domestic wire transfer, you'll need the payee's name, account number and routing number. For international wires, you'll need the currency in which the payee's account is held, the payee's name, foreign address, account number and destination routing information. Start with the “Add Payee” step by choosing the wire destination, currency (for foreign wires) and adding the payee's details. (For your protection, the initial wire transfer to a new payee may be held for up to two (2) business days for review) Complete a one-time Wires Enrollment (this step is only required for first-time wires) Send money to your payee Sign in to initiate a wire transfer via Citi's Payment Hub."
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      ]

mainEntity.name: What types of bank accounts does Citi offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Citi offers Checking, Savings and Certificate of Deposit (CD) accounts to help you with your finances. You can choose between an Access Checking or Regular Checking account depending on your banking needs. With a Citi savings account, you can earn interest, get access to cash and save seamlessly with automatic transfers. In addition, Citi offers multiple CD term options ranging from three (3) months to five (5) years. You can enjoy Relationship Tier benefits and features when you open and maintain an eligible deposit account in addition to meeting a Balance Range of at least $30,000 within three (3) calendar months. Note: some benefits will vary, depending on which types of accounts you have.1

Through simplified banking, Citi is transforming the customer experience – whether you’re managing your everyday finances or growing your wealth. This includes streamlining our checking and savings products, providing new ways to waive Monthly Service Fees, introducing Relationship Tiers for increased benefits and features, and automatically linking Eligible Deposit and Investment accounts you own to help you meet balance requirements. Learn more about simplified banking.

mainEntity.name: What is required to open a bank account online with Citi?

acceptedAnswer.text: To apply online, you must be a U.S. citizen or a U.S. resident alien and at least 18 years old. You'll need to provide a physical address in the U.S., date of birth and applicable identification documentation which may include a Social Security Number or Individual Taxpayer Identification number.

mainEntity.name: How do I open a Citibank Online account?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get started with Citibank Online, you'll first need to open an account with Citi. Then, you'll need your Citi Credit/Debit Card or Bank Account number to set up online access. Once you’ve gathered all the necessary information, go to citi.com/register and follow the steps. You’ll need to enter the last four digits of your Social Security number or Individual Taxpayer Identification number and create a username and password.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with mobile banking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Getting started with Citi's mobile banking requires a few simple steps: Open an account with Citi. Visit citi.com/register to set up your login information and security authentication. This will require you to enter the last four digits of your Social Security number or Individual Taxpayer Identification number and set up a username and password. Download and open the free Citi Mobile banking app2 using the same login information you set up on Citi.com. Alternatively, you can set up your login information and security authentication directly in the Citi Mobile app. Once you've followed these steps, you'll be able to access mobile banking with ease.

mainEntity.name: How does Mobile Check Deposit work?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a Mobile Check Deposit2 with your Citi account, you'll first need to log in to your Citi Mobile app,2 then select “Payments” from the menu. Once there, select “Deposit Checks.” To complete a one-time enrollment before using the service, review and accept the terms & conditions. Select the account you're depositing the check into and enter the amount of the check (limits may apply). Once you've filled in those details, endorse your check and take a picture of the front and back through the mobile app. Tap “Submit” to upload the photos, and you will receive a confirmation email from Citi to let you know your check has been deposited.

mainEntity.name: How do online wire transfers work with Citi?

acceptedAnswer.text: An online wire transfer allows you to send money from your Citibank account to accounts at other financial institutions in the US and internationally. Depending on the international destination, a wire may be sent in USD or in the local foreign currency. To initiate a domestic wire transfer, you'll need the payee's name, account number and routing number. For international wires, you'll need the currency in which the payee's account is held, the payee's name, foreign address, account number and destination routing information. Start with the “Add Payee” step by choosing the wire destination, currency (for foreign wires) and adding the payee's details. (For your protection, the initial wire transfer to a new payee may be held for up to two (2) business days for review) Complete a one-time Wires Enrollment (this step is only required for first-time wires) Send money to your payee Sign in to initiate a wire transfer via Citi's Payment Hub.

Citi® Flex Pay Guide

How to Use Citi® Flex Pay for Your Next Trip

Sep 02, 2026

Read Time: 2.5 min

Key insights:

  • Citi® Flex Pay lets you split eligible travel purchases into fixed monthly payments
  • You can still earn points, miles, cash back or rebates when booking travel with your Citi credit card
  • Discover a more flexible way to travel—book through Citi Travel and pay over time with Citi® Flex Pay.

Planning a trip often means managing multiple expenses at once. Citi® Flex Pay can help by turning eligible purchases into predictable monthly payments, allowing you to book freely and continue earning your credit card points, miles, rebates or cash back along the way.

What is Citi® Flex Pay?

Citi® Flex Pay is a benefit available on eligible Citi credit cards that allows you to break-up eligible purchases of $75 or more into fixed, monthly payments over a set period of time.

Instead of paying for your entire trip upfront, you can:

  • Choose a payment plan that fits your budget
  • Make equal monthly payments
  • Pay a fixed monthly Plan Fee instead of interest

Your Flex Pay payment is automatically included in your minimum payment due each billing cycle, so everything stays streamlined.

Citi® Flex Pay. Available for eligible Citi credit card customers for eligible purchases of $75 or more.

Learn More

How to use Citi® Flex Pay for travel

Using Citi® Flex Pay for your next trip can be simple and flexible.

1. Book your travel

Start by booking your trip using your eligible Citi credit card. You can book:

  • Flights
  • Hotels
  • Car rentals
  • Activities and experiences

You can also explore Citi Travel®, where you can reserve travel and earn or redeem ThankYou® Points while enjoying competitive pricing on hotels and customer service is available 24/7.

2. Select eligible purchases

Once your purchase posts to your account, look for transactions of $75 or more that are eligible for Citi® Flex Pay.

Another way to pay is through the Citi Travel website. Eligible Citi Travel customers are offered Flex Pay at checkout while making a purchase of $75 or more and can enroll with just one click.

3. Choose your plan

Select the purchase and review your options. You’ll see:

  • Your fixed monthly payment
  • The length of your plan
  • Your total Plan Fee. This gives you a clear view of your payment plan before confirming.
  • Finalize your card payment details, then view and accept the cancellation policy.
  • Lastly you will need to select Citi Flex Pay. 
    • For easy enrollment Citi Travel customers are eligible for 1-click enrollment.
    • With a single click during check out customers can select the box next to ”Buy now, pay later with Citi Flex Pay on your card” and the purchase will be automatically enrolled in a 12-month payment plan with $0 fees and no interest.

4. Pay over time

After enrolling, your monthly Flex Pay amount is added to your minimum payment due each billing cycle until the balance is paid off.

Citi® Flex Pay on Citi Travel®. Available for eligible Citi credit card customers for eligible purchases of $75 or more.

Use Citi Flex Pay

Citi Travel®

Citi Travel is a booking site for eligible Citi® cardmembers, providing a convenient way to reserve hotels, flights, car rentals and attractions. Plus, eligible Citi® cardmembers can earn and redeem ThankYou® Points on eligible travel purchases and enjoy exclusive Citi Travel benefits.

Why use Citi® Flex Pay for travel?

Citi® Flex helps to offer a simple way to manage travel expenses while still enjoying the benefits of your credit card. By using it, you can take advantage of:

  • Flexible payments: Spread out larger costs into fixed monthly amounts
  • Clear structure: Know your payment amount and timeline upfront
  • Reward opportunities: Continue earning ThankYou® points on eligible purchases
  • Seamless experience: Payments are added to your minimum monthly payment

Using Citi® Flex Pay for your travel

Citi® Flex Pay offers flexibility by allowing you to break down larger eligible travel purchases into predictable monthly payments. When combined with tools like the Citi Travel® website and the benefits of Citi® credit cards, it helps to create a well-rounded approach to planning, booking and enjoying your travel experience.

It does not indicate the availability of any Citi product or service. For advice about your specific circumstances, you should consult a qualified professional.

  const CSP_MEDIA_ATTR = 'ngCspMedia';
  const documentElement = document.documentElement;

  // Listener for load events on link tags.
  const listener = (e) => {
    const target = e.target;
    if (
      !target ||
      target.tagName !== 'LINK' ||
      !target.hasAttribute(CSP_MEDIA_ATTR)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    target.media = target.getAttribute(CSP_MEDIA_ATTR);
    target.removeAttribute(CSP_MEDIA_ATTR);

    if (!document.head.querySelector(`link[${CSP_MEDIA_ATTR}]`)) {
      documentElement.removeEventListener('load', listener);
    }
  };

  documentElement.addEventListener('load', listener, true);
})();</script><link rel="stylesheet" href="/credit-cards/static-assets/styles-ZSQ5XHW5.css" media="print" ngCspMedia="all"><noscript><link rel="stylesheet" Merchants must submit charges under the appropriate merchant code or industry code to be eligible as Qualifying Online Purchases and\u002For Net Qualifying Purchases in the different categories. mainEntity.name: What is the My Best Buy® Credit Card?

acceptedAnswer.text: The My Best Buy® Credit Card offered by Best Buy® and Citibank allows you to access reward and financing options for your Best Buy® Purchases.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the My Best Buy® Credit Card and My Best Buy® Visa® Card?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference between the My Best Buy® Credit Card and the My Best Buy® Visa® Card is the My Best Buy® Visa® Card can be used outside of Best Buy® where Visa® is accepted. The My Best Buy® Credit Card can only be used for purchases at Best Buy®.

mainEntity.name: How do I redeem My Best BuyTM reward points?

acceptedAnswer.text: Log in to your My Best BuyTM account to redeem your reward points for reward certificates, which can then be used on qualifying purchases at Best Buy®.

mainEntity.name: How are my points calculated with the My Best Buy® Credit Card and My Best Buy® Visa® Card?

acceptedAnswer.text: All qualifying purchases at Best Buy® earn 5% back in rewards (2.5 points for every $1 spent). With the My Best Buy® Visa® card, you can earn 1.5 points per $1 spent at gas stations (3% back in rewards), 1 point per $1 spent at restaurants, bars and grocery stores (2% back in rewards) and 1 point per $2 spent (1% back in rewards) on other purchases outside Best Buy® or Pacific Sales® Kitchen & Home® Stores.

mainEntity.name: How can I find out about current financing offers at Best Buy®?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visit My Best Buy® Credit Cards to see limited time and everyday financing offers at Best Buy®.

mainEntity.name: Read more My Best Buy® Credit Card FAQs

Citi® Flex Pay Guide

What is Buy Now, Pay Later and How Does It Work?

Oct 26, 2025

Buy now, pay later or BNPL is a form of financing that allows you to break up your total purchase into fixed monthly payments that are paid back over a defined period of time. Usually these buy now pay later service providers charge a fixed interest rate or fee, but other pricing structures can also apply. For many, a buy now pay later program offers customers financial flexibility for their purchases when needed, but there are factors that should be considered in order to select the best option and be confident in your choice.

Let’s explore how some buy now, pay later programs work, how to use it and tips for using it responsibly.

How does Buy Now, Pay Later work?

When shopping online you may see “pay later”, or “pay over time” as a payment option at checkout in-app or online. If you agree to the terms provided by the specific buy now pay later (BNPL) service, which can vary; the “pay over time” service will allow you to split your total purchase into several smaller payments which are then paid back over time.

Common installment lending plans include monthly or bi-weekly payments, which may automatically withdraw or charge against from the source you specify. This source can be a checking account or your credit card.

For example, a common type of BNPL program splits the transaction into 4 equal payments, spread over 6 weeks. In specific cases, you may also have an option to pay 0% interest or $0 fee on those payments for a specific repayment period. For example, a customer may see “get 0% APR on a 3-month payment plan or $0 fee on a 3-month payment plan.”

Another commonly found option is to access BNPL through third-party payment platforms, which are available through specific merchant websites at the time of purchase. These platforms will provide varying payment options like “pay in 30 days” or “Pay over time” however they also often require a credit check and an application to manage your payments.

In some instances, the ability to “pay over time” may be also accessible as a feature or benefit of a credit card you already have and use.

Buy now, pay later with Citi® Flex Pay. Available for eligible Citi credit card customers on eligible purchases of $75 or more.

Learn More

Citi® Flex Pay, is a card benefit offered to existing eligible Citi® credit card holders. The way this program works is the full amount of the eligible purchase will be deducted from your credit card’s available credit at the time of purchase. You can then select the transaction after it has posted to your account and create a fixed monthly payment plan. On your statement, the repayment amount will be added to your credit card’s Minimum Payment Due each month until the Flex Pay amount is paid in full.

Steps to using Buy Now, Pay Later

The steps to start using a pay over time or BNPL product can vary depending on the individual service or fintech. In general, there are 3 steps to set up a payment plan:

  • Select your eligible purchase(s): Lenders may have requirements around how many purchases you can enroll in a buy now pay later plan. Qualifying transactions may range anywhere from less than $100 to thousands of dollars.
  • Choose your payment option: Based on the service chosen, you may be able to choose between several payment options for your transaction. These can vary from a few weeks to several months. You will need to select the option that best fits your needs.
  • Review and confirm your plan: Before finalizing any BNPL transaction, take the time to confirm your payment terms and details. Review your plan, then select “Agree and Continue”. You’re now all set! Based on your chosen service you will likely receive a confirmation email detailing your payment plan, monthly payment amount, any fees or interest being charged, when it will begin and when your plan it is expected to end.

Advantages of Buy Now, Pay Later

Provided you have the available credit upfront, the ability to pay over time with a BNPL service or benefit may help you fund medium to large purchases such as a new TV or piece of furniture. Additionally, the flexibility to pay off the purchase in several small fixed monthly payments can be useful and convenient.

With proper planning, the ability to pay for your purchase in fixed monthly payments offered by a buy now, pay later service (BNPL) may also help you budget for larger or unplanned expenses.

Buy Now, Pay Later: Common considerations

Before you choose to pay over time, you may want to consider factors like the payment plans you’re offered, how much you can reasonably afford, eligibility requirements and credit card rewards.

1. Payment plans

When you check out, you may be presented with several BNPL offers that you can choose from. These can be APR or Fee-based. While these plans can give you the flexibility you need to split up your purchase, you also need to choose what works best for you. You may want to consider how many payments you can commit to as well as the re-payment amount and frequency of your installment agreement.

2. Eligibility

To qualify for a BNPL installment plan, lenders generally check the following criteria:

  • Your credit score and credit history
  • The cost of your purchase
  • The funds (available credit) on your payment method, such as your credit card
  • Your salary or income
  • Your prior history with the BNPL provider or credit card issuer, which can include how long you’ve had an account, past purchases, payment history and outstanding loans

It’s also important to note that your creditworthiness may be evaluated each time you opt to use an individual BNPL service.

If you use a pay later program through your credit card, a credit check and an application may or may not be required to get started. It’s important to check the requirements upfront.

In the case of Citi® Flex Pay, there is no credit check or application needed since it is a benefit of your existing Citi credit card.

3. Credit card rewards

Typically, if you use a reward credit card, you may also be able to earn points, miles, cash back, or a statement credits on those purchases depending on the type of rewards your card offers.

Using Buy Now, Pay Later responsibly

The biggest factor in choosing to pay over time with a BNPL program is to make sure you responsibly manage the payments to help avoid late fees and remain in good standing with your bank or fintech. Depending on your repayment method, you may want to set a reminder to review the connected account to make sure those will go through smoothly.

Here are some other tips to keep track of your purchase made with a pay over time provider:

  • Carefully review the program terms and conditions: Look for fees and interest rates so that you're aware of the scope of the repayment agreement before you finalize your plan.
  • Consider how the payments fit your budget: Make sure you can afford the payments to avoid running into possible late fees and defaulting on your plan so you remain in good standing.
  • Prioritize no-interest BNPL payment plans, if possible: These options may help you save on interest, compared to alternatives where the fee or APR rate may be higher.
  • Limit how many BNPL plans you have at one time: This way, you may avoid potentially overstretching your personal finances and have trouble sticking to the repayment plan.

In general, some pay over time programs can provide alternative ways to pay that may make it easier to plan for certain purchases. If you use these tools responsibly, you may be able to avoid potential pitfalls while capitalizing on the benefits.

Citi. The Benefits of Buy Now, Pay Later. Buy Now, Pay Later can fund small to medium purchases, allowing you to finance everyday transactions.
